offering_description.value: Multi-state cannabis operator that cultivates, processes and sells cannabis products. It sells branded products wholesale to dispensaries and retail through its own dispensaries, and it also develops and leases cultivation and processing facilities to licensed operators.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; edibles; vape and concentrate products; infused topicals

primary_services.value: cannabis retail dispensary operation; facility development and management for licensed operators

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients at company dispensaries; B2B: third-party licensed dispensaries buying wholesale, licensed operators leasing facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold at retail and wholesale to dispensaries; rental or leasing: rent from licensed operators leasing cultivation and processing facilities; service fees: management and real estate development fees from licensed operators
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows and processes cannabis into branded products sold to dispensaries; retailer: operates dispensaries selling directly to consumers and patients; asset operator: owns and leases cultivation and processing real estate to licensed operators

geography_served.value: US regional: Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Delaware, Nevada, Ohio and other state markets

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis cultivation, branded products, retail dispensaries and facility leasing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned cannabis dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries; direct sales: licensing and leasing to licensed operators
distribution_channels.category: own locations; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licenses required, federal illegality under the Controlled Substances Act, state cannabis regulators

notes: State footprint and brand licensing details may have changed.
